# NEWSROOM


## UTStarcom highlights the huge potential of ‘Nextgen Access & Transport India 2015’


With a mission to support India in creating a ‘Superior Digital Highway', UTStarcom (NASDAQ: UTSI), a global telecommunications infrastructure provider today announced its aggressive plans and product portfolio for transport, aggregation and access networking solutions for Indian market in ‘Nextgen Access & Transport India 2015’.
